subcommittees.name: Railroads, Pipelines, and Hazardous Materials Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Affects members of the Armed Forces, veterans, supply chain employers, and personnel across multiple federal departments.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of Transportation, in consultation with the Secretary of Defense, Secretary of Veterans Affairs, and Secretary of Labor, shall develop and make public an action plan

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a planning, study, and reporting directive rather than mandatory operational changes or direct spending programs.
Requires administrative planning actions within existing agency structures without specifying funding changes.
Directs a specific interagency federal plan and identification of workforce barriers and regulatory challenges.
dimensions.evidence: identify... barriers members of the Armed Forces... and veterans face when searching for employment... in the supply chain industry

dimensions.assessment: Primarily focuses on a one-time action plan to be developed not later than 30 days after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 30 days after the date of enactment of this Act... shall develop and make public an action plan

missing_information: Specific budgetary allocations for executing the action plan are not mentioned.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the Department of Transportation, in consultation with other agencies, to develop and publish a one-time action plan addressing veteran employment in the supply chain industry.
